  AGENDA
  OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CA 90274

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business
referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public
inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council
after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's
office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda
item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and
documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to
persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact
the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-
related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings;
however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or
make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the
City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting
room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute
preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to
meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the
Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry
concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior
to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
 The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting
will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant
to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health
Officer’s Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference
meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.

HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe
the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You
may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88927944270
  Zoom Meeting ID: 889 2794 4270
  BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 88927944270#

HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email
correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be
distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be
provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.

HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the
meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email
CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you’d like to speak, and (2) the
phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will
replace the in-person speaker cards.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on
the City’s website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

  10. CONSIDERATION OF REQUEST BY THE PALOS VERDES GOLF CLUB FOR AN ADJUSTMENT TO
  THE 2021 ANNUAL CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT FUND BUDGET FOR IMPROVEMENTS TO THE
  DINING  ROOM

  Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) approve the request from
  the Palos Verdes Golf Club (PVGC) to increase their 2021 Capital Improvement Fund (CIF)
  budget by $550,000 for the dining room remodel project (Project), for a total 2021 CIF
  budget of $5,126,300; 2) require the PVGC to seek approval of the City Council Liaisons in
  advance of any contingency fund expenditures in excess of $10,000 for any capital project
  expenditure unless such expenditure is emergency in nature; and 3) require the PVGC to
  report back with actual expenditures for all CIF projects as part of their annual budget
  approval process. MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
